title: Blue Suede Shoes Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: A perennial Seaside favorite, Blue Suede Shoes is located just minutes away from the beach, Central Square and pools. This cherished cottage recently underwent a major renovation.
description_expanded: Description52 E. RUSKIN STREET2 KING BEDS, 1 SLEEPER SOFAPrime Seaside Location Near Central Square & the BeachWelcome to Blue Suede Shoes, a charming Seaside cottage ideally located just a short stroll from Central Square, Seaside’s family and adult pools, and the sugar-white beaches along Scenic Highway 30A. Tucked into one of Seaside’s most walkable neighborhoods, this inviting retreat places you steps from shops, dining, and iconic coastal experiences—perfect for guests who want to park the car and fully enjoy life in Seaside, Florida.Inviting Front Porch & Coastal Living SpacesThe home welcomes you with a wide, open front porch that spans the entire width of the cottage, offering ample lounge seating and a front-row view of Seaside’s picturesque streetscape. Inside, the open-concept living area blends cozy comfort with refined coastal style, featuring plush seating and a flat-screen TV—ideal for relaxing after a beach day. A custom built-in dining bench lines the window, comfortably seating six and creating a warm gathering space for shared meals and conversation. A modern half bath is conveniently located on the first floor.Renovated Kitchen & Charming Dining NooksThe recently renovated walk-through kitchen features stainless steel appliances, thoughtful finishes, and barstool seating for casual bites or entertaining while cooking. Just beyond the kitchen, a charming bistro dining nook for two provides the perfect setting for morning coffee or a quiet breakfast before heading to the beach.First-Floor King Suite with Private PorchAlso on the main level, the king bedroom suite offers a peaceful retreat with direct access to a private screened-in porch, furnished for outdoor relaxation. The newly renovated en suite bathroom completes this serene space, ideal for guests seeking convenience and privacy on the first floor.Loft Workspace & Second-Floor Primary SuiteUpstairs, a bright loft area overlooks the kitchen below and features a king sleeper sofa, desk, and open windows—perfect for remote work or additional sleeping space. The second-floor king primary suite is spacious and well-appointed, featuring a mounted flat-screen TV and an expansive primary bathroom with a double vanity for added comfort.Outdoor Dining & Added AmenitiesOut back, enjoy evenings under the stars in the outdoor dining area, perfect for relaxed dinners with family and friends. Additional amenities include a charcoal grill, outdoor shower, and a dedicated laundry room, adding convenience to your Seaside stay.Your Seaside Home Away From HomeWhether you're planning a family vacation, a couples’ getaway, or a longer coastal escape, Blue Suede Shoes offers comfort, style, and an unbeatable location in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Come experience the charm, walkability, and timeless beauty of this beloved beach community.* Please be advised that some exterior areas of this home are under video surveillance.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES1,605 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at East Ruskin PavilionSeaside offers the largest private residential beach on Scenic 30AJust 276 feet (1-minute walk) to beach accessLocated on the east side of Seaside, close to parks and town amenitiesOutdoor dining area at the rear of the homeOutdoor rain shower for rinsing off after beach daysPrivate parking directly in front of the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest services throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking passes: 1 pass for one-bedroom cottages, 2 passes for two-bedroom and larger homes. Golf carts are considered vehiclesGolf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners in Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002178
